summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing the filing of an NI 43-101 technical report for its Los Gatos Silver Mine, which it operates with a 70% interest. The technical report updates mineral resource and reserve estimates with an effective date of December 31, 2025, showing no material change from prior disclosures. The report was prepared by qualified persons and filed voluntarily on SEDAR+, not in connection with a material change or prospectus. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of technical data, not a special situation transaction, thus no deal terms or strategic actions are involved.
